# About this repository

This is the source repository for developing and releasing MarkdStage. Treat
requests as software-engineering work unless the user explicitly asks to present
or edit a deck.

## Sources of truth

- `.github/extensions/markdstage/` is the canonical Canvas Extension, shared
  renderer, runtime, schema, and guide source.
- `packages/markdstage-cli/` mirrors the portable Extension sources into its
  generated `shared/` directory before testing and packing.
- Agent Skills are generated by
  `packages/markdstage-cli/src/skills.mjs` from the canonical guide topics and
  installed into user workspaces by the CLI or Desktop. Do not add generated
  MarkdStage Skills under this repository's `.github/skills/`, `.agents/skills/`,
  or `.claude/skills/` directories.
- `.github/plugin/markdstage/` is generated from the canonical Extension. Use
  `npm run awesome:sync` to update it and `npm run awesome:check` to verify it.
- Current cross-surface structure and invariants live in
  `docs/architecture.md`.
- Architecture decisions live in `docs/adr/`. Temporary cross-surface
  implementation specifications live in `docs/specs/`.

## Development rules

- Make shared parser, renderer, validation, export, and guide changes in the
  canonical Extension source first; do not hand-edit generated mirrors.
- Preserve equivalent behavior across Canvas, npm CLI, packaged CLI, and Desktop
  unless an accepted ADR explicitly defines a surface difference.
- Keep workspace paths confined and host-validated. Do not weaken canonical path,
  link traversal, origin, size-limit, or atomic-write protections.
- Run the smallest relevant tests first, then the cross-surface checks required by
  the affected source paths.

## Release requests

- When asked to release, publish, or tag a new version, read and follow
  `.github/RELEASING.md` before taking any action.
- Treat `.github/RELEASING.md` as the canonical release checklist. Do not infer
  missing steps from repository history or duplicate the checklist elsewhere.
